about: Process plan for NIST FTC-10 on the shop's Haas VF-2 with a 6 in Kurt D688. Written by Claude from the drawing (nist_ftc_10_asme1_rb) and the STEP model; every feature below is checked against the model by moonshot/planning/validate.py. Model frame: Y is height (the Y=0 face is datum A, the pocket side), X is length, Z is width.

stock.material_note: The drawing specifies none; 6061-T6 is the shop's default for a precision housing

workholding.note: Stock on 1 in parallels, 0.25 in proud of the jaws

wcs.x: the centre of the stock's length
wcs.by: edge finder in X and Y; tool setter for Z

operations.what: Face datum A flat (flatness 0.2) and to height
Profile the body and the four mounting ears to the model outline
Rough and finish the pocket 17 mm deep (profile 1.2 to A B C)
Drill 8X Ø2.5 ±0.15 from the pocket floor into the cross bores (note 4)
Drill 4X Ø6 ±0.15 through the mounting ears

workholding.note: Flipped onto datum A; clamp on the finished sides

wcs.z: datum A on the parallels, plus 31 mm

operations.what: Face to the 31 mm overall height
Rough and finish the four Ø16 humps and the Ø25 hollows between them
Mill the oval boss and the three coplanar pads (datum D)
Drill and ream 3X Ø3.5 G6 to D B C
Counterbore the ears Ø10 and spot Ø18

workholding.note: On its side; soft jaws protect the humps
Rolled over; the bores from Op 30 locate it

operations.what: Counterbore 4X Ø10 ±0.25, 10 ±0.2 deep, coaxial with the bores

workholding.note: Standing on end against a stop; check it's square with the indicator

operations.what: Peck-drill both Ø5.5 ±0.2 holes from this end, 35 ±1 and 27.5 ±1 deep

finish.what: Deburr every edge, break the sharp corners of the pocket and the cross holes
Check the pocket depth, the 31 mm height, the Ø3.5 G6 pins with gauge pins, the M3 threads with a go/no-go gauge, and the Ø7 bores

step_pattern.about: Every VF-2 setup is shown as these instruction steps; the first setup also loads its tools
steps: Clean the vise and set the parallels
Seat it and tighten the vise
Find X and Y with the edge finder
Set Z with the tool setter
Close the door and start the cycle
Watch each operation (a few seconds each)
Blow off the chips and unload
